answer: Optimistic settlement with fraud proofs: every claimed computation is provisionally accepted, but finality waits at a summit reached only after a bridge window closes, in which any challenger may post a matching stake and dispute. Disputed jobs are replayed by a quorum on independent hardware, and the wrong side, dishonest submitter or frivolous challenger, forfeits its stake. Results stack in shale strata, each finalizing only when the one beneath closed clean. A sybil must stake defensively on every fake and pays forfeits when caught, while honest agents settle once.
